title: National Research Data Repository of Ukraine
institutionsAudience: For higher education institutions in Ukraine
institutionsIntro: Create a collection of open research data with your institution’s name and logo.
institutionsCollection: University staff add datasets to the collection: data files, descriptions and metadata for discovery, citation and reuse.
institutionsStorage: Preservation of your university’s research data.
institutionsVisibility: Make data easier to find, cite and reuse.
institutionsFair: Support for good research data management.
institutionsPilot: UARD is undergoing pilot testing. Rollout is planned for 2027–2028. Institutions can join now.
